input.free_text_description: This system is a authentication platform that serves User, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for custom user detail, balance mode, completed ticket. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include task management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to interact with balance mode functionality, so that I can accomplish my balance mode-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with completed ticket functionality, so that I can accomplish my completed ticket-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with future ticket functionality, so that I can accomplish my future ticket-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with goal functionality, so that I can accomplish my goal-related tasks.
